abilities.name: Tail Whip
abilities.rawDescription:
Odd-numbered rounds 1, 3, 5, 7, and 9: deal Physical Damage to 1 enemy in the same lane at a +100% Damage Rate, scaling with Strength and mitigated by target Instinct.

At 6+ Stars, Barbed Lash augments Tail Whip on even-numbered rounds 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10: deal Physical Damage to 1 enemy in the same lane using Barbed Lash's direct rate, then attempt Bleed on the same target for 2 rounds. Bleed deals Physical Damage each round at a fixed +20% rate; Bleed scaling and mitigation are not stated. At 6+ Stars Thunderstrike attacks on every numbered round.

abilities.name: Warrior's Zeal
abilities.rawDescription: At Dragon Level 16+ while Thunderstrike is Vanguard: increase Thunderstrike's Physical Damage from Active Commands and Habits by +16%. Increase Instinct and Initiative of the same Left Flank ally by +20 each. The self Physical boost excludes Basic Attacks.

abilities.name: Battle Rush
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of Round 1 for 3 rounds: increase Thunderstrike Initiative and reduce Instinct of the same 2 enemies within adjacency. Strength enhances the enemy Instinct reduction, not the self Initiative increase. The enemy reduction is direct and is not a named status.

Progression: Habit Level 1: self Initiative +25%, enemy Instinct -15%; Level 2: +30%, -18%; Level 3: +35%, -21%; Level 4: +42.5%, -25.5%; Level 5: +50%, -30%.

Power: 250 / 550 / 900 / 1300 / 1800

abilities.name: Dragon's Might
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of combat until end: increase Thunderstrike's Physical Damage from Active Commands and Habits. Self-only; excludes Basic Attacks.

Progression: Habit Level 1: +8%; Level 2: +9.6%; Level 3: +11.2%; Level 4: +13.6%; Level 5: +16%.

Power: 250 / 550 / 900 / 1300 / 1800

abilities.name: Barbed Lash
abilities.rawDescription:
Augments Tail Whip on even-numbered rounds with one direct Physical strike and one Bleed attempt against the same target. Bleed lasts 2 rounds and its Damage Rate remains +20% each round. The table rate applies only to the direct strike.

Progression (Bleed chance / even-round direct rate): Habit Level 1: 25% / +50%; Level 2: 30% / +60%; Level 3: 35% / +70%; Level 4: 42.5% / +85%; Level 5: 50% / +100%.

Power: 250 / 550 / 900 / 1300 / 1800

abilities.name: Armor Break
abilities.rawDescription:
Start of combat until end: increase Physical Damage Received by 1 opposing enemy. This is direct typed Physical amplification, not the named Vulnerable status. The exact meaning of opposing enemy remains unresolved and creates no ally placement rule.

Progression: Habit Level 1: +4.8%; Level 2: +5.67%; Level 3: +6.72%; Level 4: +8.16%; Level 5: +9.6%.

Power: 250 / 550 / 900 / 1300 / 1800

abilities.name: Staggering Assault
abilities.rawDescription:
Each round: chance to apply Stagger to 1 enemy in the same lane for 1 round. Stagger prevents Attack Modifier Commands and Basic Attacks. If Thunderstrike has Advantage, Stagger lasts 2 rounds instead; Advantage changes duration, not activation chance. Stagger satisfies the broad Control family without becoming a duplicate provider.

Progression (Stagger chance): Habit Level 1: 10%; Level 2: 13%; Level 3: 16%; Level 4: 20%; Level 5: 25%.

Power: 250 / 580 / 1000 / 1600 / 2300
